claims.text: Smokers: a quit plan w pharmacotherapy (varenicline, bupropion and/or NRT) + counseling and/or a cessation program.
claims.quote: should be assisted in developing a plan for quitting that includes pharmacotherapy (ie, varenicline, bupropion, and/or nicotine replacement therapies) combined with counseling, and/or referral to a smoking cessation program.
